easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have one or more basic land cards in your library.
description:
Cast Scouting Trek by paying {1}{G}, searching your library for all basic land cards and putting them onto the top of your library.
Play a land.
When the land enters, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a 3/4 Treefolk creature token.
When the Treefolk enters, Fecund Greenshell triggers, putting the top card of your library onto the battlefield tapped as it will be a land.
Repeat from step 3 until the top card of your library isn't a land.
